accepted_answers: In an age when people are living longer and longer, dementia has been seen as one of the greatest challenges that many families must face.

patterns: 分詞片語後位修飾名詞（diagnosed with …）

1.explanation_zh: 「在人們越活越長的時代」的修飾語很長，英文用關係副詞子句放在名詞後：In an era when people live longer（越來越長也可寫 are living longer and longer）。「失智症已被視為…」用完成式被動 has been regarded as，as 不能省。「許多家庭必須面對的最大挑戰之一」寫 one of the biggest challenges (that) many households have to cope with（face、deal with），「之一」後面用複數 challenges，cope／deal 後面的 with 不能省。
evidence: 在人們越活越長的時代
1.strategy_zh: 「在…的時代／時候」用 in an age (at a time) when + 子句；「已被視為」用 has been regarded as。
hints: 切成四段：在人們越活越長的時代／失智症（dementia）已被視為／許多家庭必須面對的／最大挑戰之一
標的詞彙：age（時代）、people（人們）、live（活）、long（長的）、regard（視為）、family（家庭）、face（面對）、big（大的）、challenge（挑戰）
句型框架：In an era when + S + V …, S + has been regarded as one of the biggest + N(複數) + (that) + S + have to V.

2.explanation_zh: 「許多家庭都無法確定，是否該讓…」：「是否該…」是放在句子裡的問句，用 whether they should let …（或 whether to let …），直述句語序。「被診斷出失智症的長輩」修飾語在前，英文改成過去分詞片語後位修飾 elderly relatives diagnosed with dementia（be diagnosed with + 病名）。「讓…繼續一個人住在老家」是 let + 受詞 + continue to live alone in their old homes；let 後面接原形動詞，「一個人」是 alone，不是 lonely。
evidence: 被診斷出失智症（dementia）的長輩
2.strategy_zh: 「不確定是否…」用 not sure whether + S + V；「被診斷出…的人」用「名詞 + diagnosed with + 病名」。
hints: 切成四段：許多家庭都無法確定／是否該讓／被診斷出失智症（dementia）的長輩／繼續一個人住在老家
標的詞彙：family（家庭）、sure（確定的）、whether（是否）、let（讓）、elderly（年長的）、diagnose（診斷）、continue（繼續）、alone（獨自）、home（家）
句型框架：S + are not sure whether + S + should let + N + diagnosed with … + continue to VR …

traps.zh: 在人們越活越長的時代
traps.literal_error: In the people-living-longer-and-longer era, dementia has been regarded as …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「…的時代」修飾語在前，英文要改成 an age when + 子句，放在名詞後面。

traps.literal_error: …dementia has been regarded as one of the biggest challenge many households have to cope with.
traps.explanation_zh: 「…之一」one of the + 複數名詞，challenge 要加 s。

bonus.text: As people live ever longer, dementia has come to be seen as one of the toughest challenges confronting families.
bonus.explanation_zh: ever longer（越來越長）、has come to be seen as（漸漸被視為）、confronting families（家庭所面臨的）是進階寫法；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「在人們越活越長的時代」修飾語在前，英文改成關係副詞子句 In an era when people live longer；「許多家庭必須面對的最大挑戰之一」改成 one of the biggest challenges (that) many households have to cope with（face）。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：「在人們越活越長的時代」In an age／era（At a time）+ when（in which）+ people are living longer (and longer)、people live longer and longer；「失智症已被視為」dementia has been／is + regarded as／seen as／considered (to be)／viewed as；「許多家庭必須面對的」(that／which) many families（households）+ have to／must + face／deal with／cope with，寫 faced by many families、facing many families、for many families 也可以；「最大挑戰之一」one of the biggest／greatest challenges。另外也給分：In an age／era where …、In this era when …、people are living ever longer。

traps.literal_error: Many families are not sure whether should they let elderly relatives diagnosed with dementia …
traps.explanation_zh: 「是否該…」放在句子裡當受詞，英文是間接問句，用直述句語序 whether they should …，不倒裝。

traps.literal_error: …let elderly relatives diagnosed dementia continue to live alone …
traps.explanation_zh: 「被診斷出某病」的固定搭配是 be diagnosed with + 病名；with 不能省。

bonus.text: Many families are torn over whether elderly relatives diagnosed with dementia should be allowed to go on living alone in their old homes.
bonus.explanation_zh: be torn over（為…左右為難）比 not sure 更傳神；whether 子句改用被動 should be allowed to … 也很自然。這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「是否該讓…」是放在句子裡的問句，用 whether they should let …（或 whether to let …），直述句語序；「被診斷出失智症的長輩」改成分詞片語後位修飾 elderly relatives diagnosed with dementia。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：「許多家庭都無法確定」Many families are not sure／cannot be sure／are unsure／are not certain；「是否該讓」whether (if) they should let／allow，或 whether to let／allow（let 後接原形動詞，allow 後接 to VR）；「被診斷出失智症的長輩」(their) elderly relatives／elderly family members／older relatives／elderly parents + diagnosed with dementia，寫成 who have been diagnosed with dementia 也算達成本句 PART 標的；「繼續一個人住在老家」continue to live／continue living／keep living／go on living + alone／by themselves／on their own + in their old (own) homes。另外也給分：cannot decide／are hesitant about／are not quite sure + whether …；長輩寫單數 an elderly relative (family member)／their elderly parent，後面配 in his or her old home；aging parents、seniors；remain living alone。

1.translation: In an age when people are living longer and longer, dementia has been regarded as one of the greatest challenges that many families must face.
1.explanation_zh: 「在人們越活越長的時代」用 In an age when … 關係副詞子句，配 living longer and longer；「已被視為」用現在完成式被動 has been regarded as；「最大挑戰之一」用 one of the greatest challenges，後接 that 關係子句。

2.translation: Many families are not sure whether they should let elderly relatives who have been diagnosed with dementia continue to live alone in the family home.
2.explanation_zh: 「無法確定是否」用 are not sure whether；「讓…繼續」用 let + O + continue to V；「被診斷出失智症的長輩」用關係子句 who have been diagnosed with dementia；「老家」譯 the family home。

issues_zh: 4 部分切法本身公平；但 parts[3].accepted 沒有收「in the family home」（「老家」最自然的譯法之一，意思和 in their old homes 相同），本盲譯就是這個寫法，建議補進 accepted 與 notes_zh。另「老家」也可能被學生理解成家鄉（in their hometowns），notes_zh 宜註明是否給分。
PART 標的本盲譯用的是完整關係子句 who have been diagnosed with dementia（notes_zh 明說算達成本句 PART），程式的句構比對看不出來是正常的。

1.translation: In an age when people are living longer and longer, dementia has been regarded as one of the biggest challenges that many families have to face.
1.explanation_zh: 「在人們越活越長的時代」用 In an age when people are living longer and longer；「已被視為」用現在完成式被動 has been regarded as；「最大挑戰之一」為 one of the biggest challenges，後面接 that many families have to face 修飾 challenges。

2.translation: Many families are not sure whether they should let an elderly relative who has been diagnosed with dementia continue to live alone in the family home.
2.explanation_zh: 「無法確定，是否該……」用 are not sure whether they should ...；「被診斷出失智症的長輩」用 an elderly relative who has been diagnosed with dementia；「讓……繼續一個人住」用 let ... continue to live alone；「老家」譯為 the family home。長輩是單一還是複數、老家怎麼譯有些彈性，所以信心為 medium。

issues_zh: 盲譯把「老家」譯成 in the family home（長輩用單數 an elderly relative、home 前用定冠詞），語意自然，但第 4 部分的 accepted 只有 their family homes（複數）、his or her old／own home、their old homes 等，沒有 in the family home、in their family home、in the old family home；單數長輩搭配 the family home 的組合也建議補進 accepted。
